facts.claim: Cotton and silk goods are woven chiefly at Yeola and sent to Bombay, Poona, Satara, and Sholapur.
facts.quote: Cotton and silk goods are woven chiefly at Yeola, and thence Arts and sent as far as Bombay, Poona, Satara, and Sholapur.

facts.claim: The annual exports from Yeola are valued at 25 lakhs.
facts.quote: The “^fac“ value of the annual exports from Yeola is calculated to amount to 25 lakhs.

facts.claim: The silk industry at Yeola supports 4,000 families.
facts.quote: The silk industry at this place supports 4,000 families.
